scenario: Capture/binding-form length match per LREG.4.2 — the number of binding-form names must equal the number of capturing groups in the pattern. Pin: a `where (a, b)` binding form against a pattern with three capturing groups rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_BINDING_LENGTH_MISMATCH. Path: `dsc.validate.lreg_4_1_where_capture`, counting RE2's groups (`ds.re2`).
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule trig:
    Msg m where (a, b) = m.text ~ /(\w+) (\w+) (\w+)/
->
    log info "{a} {b}"
